ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Communicating messages and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Engaging parents or and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Soil environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Improving soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Ice melting to water

2. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

4. D — 100 °C

5. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.

6. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

8. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.

9. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Caring for Soil environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Improving soil; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
